atDirectives.name: @theme
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: define design tokens (colors, spacing, fonts, breakpoints) as CSS custom properties that generate utilities.

atDirectives.name: @import
atDirectives.description: CSS at-rule that inlines another stylesheet. Tailwind v4 uses it to load 'tailwindcss' and its layers.

atDirectives.name: @custom-variant
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: register a custom variant (e.g. a dark-mode or state-based variant) for use in class names.

atDirectives.name: @utility
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: define a custom utility class that participates in the engine (variants, tree-shaking).

atDirectives.name: @variant
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: apply one or more variants to a block of plain CSS.

atDirectives.name: @apply
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS: inline existing utility classes into a custom CSS rule.

atDirectives.name: @source
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: explicitly register source paths for the engine to scan for used class names.

atDirectives.name: @reference
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: reference an existing theme/config (e.g. globals.css) without re-emitting its variables, so @apply works in isolated files.

atDirectives.name: @config
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS: load a legacy JavaScript tailwind.config file.
